title: Akashi Kaikyo Bridge
summary: The Akashi Kaikyo Bridge is a suspension bridge across the Akashi Strait between Kobe and Awaji Island in Japan. On-site construction began on 1 May 1988 and it opened on 5 April 1998. It is 3,911 m long overall with a central span of 1,991 m, and its towers rise 282.8 m.

uncertainty.note: On-site construction start (1 May 1988) and opening (5 April 1998) are from the operator; EBSCO also gives 1988 and 1998. The ground-breaking ceremony was 26 April 1986. End is the present: the bridge is in use.
